title: The Pearl set is the story's default enemies: a story page with no ?creatures runs the Cutis-Maku Pearl bodies, ?creatures=dots (or =0) the old dot clouds, the campaign board keeps its dot clouds; the first-contact card and the debrief's belts wear the Pearl tier, the program warm takes the Pearl swarms, and the hull's roll-out waits for the Rotor's first wave
context: Owner, 2026-10-14: "http://localhost:8159/index.html?intro=0#td still shows the half-dot enemies in story mode, merge and refactor what needs to be, we are adapting to the new enemies." Until now the Pearl set (src/fx/creature-enemies.js, src/fx/creature-pearl.js, src/content/pearl-enemies.js; 2026-10-13-pearl-enemies-story-mode and its rounds, 2026-10-14-pearl-waves-build-up) was built only under ?creatures=pearl, and every story page without the flag ran the Braille dot clouds. Branch pearl-default, cut from main at b354fdd1. The first browser battery under the new default (twenty-one steps) went red on five: --round6 and --round7 (the Rotor's first wave not cleared before the Stålheart stood and the roll-out took the seat: the pilot hook gone mid-wave), --gunship (the seat linked 52 shader programs, 105 -> 157: three's compile() threw on a Pearl record's stand-in, an Object3D carrying an opacity holder as `material` and no geometry), --backdoor (no fodder inside from the back breach in 180 s: 213 up, none in), --pacing (sector 1 never reached: the game clock at 118 s in the step's 900 s wall).
outcome: (1) THE DEFAULT lives in one place, the flag parser: src/platform/game-flags.js creaturesFlag reads an absent `creatures` on a story page (src/core/story-route.js isStoryRoute) as 'pearl' and dots / 0 as null, so src/fx/creature-enemies.js, the vars modal and the harness all see the same value; ?creatures=pearl and the probe forms (cutis:small, reed:..., &ramp=1) are unchanged, and a probe page's sector stays the dot clouds as before (its numbers stay comparable with 2026-10-12's). The campaign board (?acceptance=1 or ?sim= without the story) keeps null: the Pearl set does run there when asked (?acceptance=1&creatures=pearl: dressed, no errors), but at its slow gait one of wave 1's four amoebas had reached the heart in 40 s against all four in 25 s, and the acceptance runs and the wave simulator are timed on the dot clouds. (2) THE GAME UNDER THE DEFAULT: the NEW CONTACT card of a dressed record is its tier's (the swatch its skin, its core for Onyx, the tier's name over the type's role and facts: src/fx/contact-card.js contactLook); a Pearl kill is booked to its tier's belt (the phage white, the knot black, as drawn: src/fx/sector-run.js), so the debrief's ladder shows what was fought; the program warm takes drawables only and the first soft and first cored Pearl swarms are made at boot (creature-bodies / creature-pearl prepare), so --gunship's first seat links 4 (110 -> 114) as the dot clouds' 3; the hull's roll-out waits, at most STORY_ROLLOUT.firstWave (60 s) after the Stålheart stands, while the player in a sentry's optic fights the Rotor's first wave (src/fx/hull-issue.js): the Pearl swarm walks the opening's lane at its slow gait and is in the Rotor's reach at story clock ~51 against ~15 for the dot clouds, the harness cleared it at ~123 s, and the hull rolls out after it; the dot clouds' wave is cleared long before the Stålheart stands, so their opening is unchanged. The showcase montage, the story monitor and the creature probe needed nothing: the montage's swarm and rams are records (dressed at spawn; its proof under the default: 66 emerging, 118 rams), the story monitor already draws the bodies unculled (the bodies' wide view), and the probe's forms are explicit. (3) THE SUITES, all with STALHEART_BROWSER_PORT=18161, one at a time: green under the default --sectors, --round6, --round7, --waves, --story, --chapters, --opening, --finale, --seats, --gunship, --colony, --tank-shell, --laser-game, --phone, --pearl-story, --creature-probe, --swarm-pearl, --bestiary, --ground-feed; green on ?creatures=dots by choice --pacing (its 40 s first-contact contract is the 2026-09-24 pacing design's, timed at the dot clouds' speeds; the Pearl gait is the owner's open tuning, and headless the Pearl bodies drew the game clock to 118 s in 900 s wall where the dot clouds run 444 s in 450) and --backdoor's walk-in (the back door's routing, timed at the dot clouds' walk). --round7 now asserts the story runs the Pearl set with no flag and that the first card is the tier's (CUTIS-SOFT IVORY for the amoeba). CREATURES=<form> in the environment puts ?creatures=<form> on every game page a step opens that names none (the A/B). --showcase (not in the battery) is red on the base b354fdd1 as on this branch ('Isao says his landing lines after PLAY'), and the default suite stops at shell-explosion on both: pre-existing, not chased; --defense not run (red on main, the open ground-feed issue).
alternatives: The default in src/fx/creature-enemies.js (`pearl = !flags.creatures || ...`): the flags object would then say null for a story that runs the Pearl set, and every other reader (the vars modal, the harness's state) would have to know the rule; the parser is the one place.
The Pearl set on the campaign board too: it runs, but the acceptance runs and the wave simulator are timed on the dot clouds' walk; left for a decision of its own.

Thin or speed the opening's swarm under Pearl so it reaches the Rotor in time: the build-up keeps harmless fodder whole by its own rule and the gait's cap is the owner's ("slower and organic feeling is a must"); holding the roll-out for the wave changes no pace and keeps the tutorial's order (Rotor clears, then the hull).
Issue the hull quietly under a Rotor gunner, as for the gunship: the roll-out's camera run is the tank's reveal; it waits instead, at most a minute.

Lengthen --pacing's and --backdoor's budgets for the Pearl walk: headless the Pearl bodies run the game clock at about an eighth of wall time, so the steps would take hours and still measure the dot clouds' contracts.
evidence: commits 965e839c (the flag), cc085535 (the card and the belts), aa21b45d (the program warm), cdbcb406 (the roll-out's wait), 5e33e3ac (the browser steps) on pearl-default
